body.zh: 酚酞本身是一种弱酸型染料，在 pH 约 8.2 以下无色，以上变为粉红。它只“报告”pH 区间，不参与中和计量；教学模型用两个色带近似真实的渐变。
body.en: Phenolphthalein is a dye that is colorless below about pH 8.2 and pink above. It only reports a pH range and does not enter the stoichiometry; the teaching model approximates the gradual transition with two bands.
